scope: Static R5 delta review: CP1 gate and export runner binding; no export, fit, provider call, grade, or admission was performed.
findings: R5 preserves and checks the exact R4 scientific/export contract hash and referenced path; it uses a distinct R5 runner schema, CP1 gate schema, root-admission schema, and fixed attempt ID oldz4-r5-f0-s3-student-export.

Before predictor execution, the runner checks the admitted contract, R5 runner-contract hash, terminal CP1-gate hash and checkpoint hash, and export-only action. It then reruns the CP1 validator, rebinds the frozen trainer, predictor, and fit modules, binds trainer ROOT to the project, checks the actual zero-worker loader path, and rejects existing prediction, sidecar, partial, or sequence-summary outputs.

The R5 CP1 validator verifies the actual producer's checkpoint and training-state tensors are finite and that all 16 model tensors match bitwise; it validates epoch/next-epoch, recipe, history/provenance update totals, and source-qualified fold-0 fit/evaluation membership. The actual producer receipt reports 14,920 attempts, 14,913 completed updates, and 7 AMP skips; it explicitly makes no gradient-finiteness claim.

After the predictor returns, the runner checks the imported trainer and ROOT are unchanged. Export validation binds the prediction sidecar to CP1, requires the fixed 1,873 x 20,000 x 2 float32 payload, checks canonical row order, hashes the full file, and scans finiteness in bounded chunks. Fold 0 remains exposed development evidence, not a fresh holdout or public claim.
qualification: The runner enforces the R5 runner-contract JSON hash but does not self-check its own source hash or the validator source hash against root admission. Before dispatch, root should independently pin and verify both code-file hashes in the admission/run preflight (in addition to the contract hash); no export authority is implied by this review.
